attack.note: Her beam attack hits every enemy in a line and Feel the Heat gives 50 percent more damage to enemies in melee range, so her damage is mostly autos plus Particle Grenade. Short range, not a long range attacker.

poke.note: Particle Grenade has 4 charges, 80 damage and is better at high Energy. Pinpoint Accuracy adds slow at the center. It is real poke with a grenade arc that can be walked out of.

damage.note: Energy is 2 percent more damage per point, up to 100 percent. Measured hero damage 2354 per minute is above the league median, so she deals real damage, but it is built from beams and grenades that healing and constant damage keep her from building. Her damage depends on absorbing damage, so a team with little damage to absorb leaves her weak.

healing.note: Not a healer for the draft. Shield Ally is 420 for 3 seconds on a 12 second cooldown (Gain Train adds a second ally, Cleansing Shield removes crowd control). It stops a burst but expires quickly, so the guide lists weakness to sustained damage. No mana cost.

good_into.why: Personal Barrier (560) and Shield Ally (420) absorb a burst combo, and the absorbed damage becomes Energy. The guide says she shines against Jaina style burst and aggressive assassins such as Kerrigan.
Feel the Heat deals 50 percent more to enemies in melee range, Expulsion Zone knocks them back and Defensive Shielding blocks 2 hits. Melee heroes have to stand inside her beam.
The guide says Feel the Heat is best against low mobility, low range heroes, and Graviton Surge or Expulsion Zone in a choke point traps them.
Unstoppable Competitor makes her Unstoppable with Personal Barrier and Cleansing Shield removes crowd control from an ally, so she can keep a carry free.

bad_into.why: Lunara and similar heroes walk away from a short range, no mobility hero. Her Energy decays by 3 per second when she cannot absorb damage.
Shields last 3 seconds and constant chip damage (Raynor, Chromie) outlasts them, and the damage she absorbs is only Energy if it comes in bursts. Varian Shattering Throw breaks them.
She has no mobility and cannot catch a Genji or Tracer. The guide says blinds are quite effective against her because much of her damage is basic attacks.
Displacement such as Wrecking Ball and skillshots (Maiev) hit her because she has no escape, and her own crowd control is only two heroics.

wants_from_team: a marksman or burst hero that benefits from her shields (Valla, a sustain healer like Malfurion)
a main tank, a solid offlaner and a healer, because she covers none of these
an offlaner who can double soak on three lane maps
choke points around objectives for her heroics
weaknesses: shields are short and break against constant damage
depends on incoming damage for Energy
evidence: measured: hero damage 2354 per minute, healing 774 (shield absorbed), merc camps 4.4 per game, win rate 0.459, 172 games
